title: ChecklistDateMove
description: A wedding date that moved while its checklist had tasks (issue #31): recorded by the server when the wedding's date changes, so the offer to move the open tasks is built from server data, never from a URL. Keyed by wedding_id; removed when the planner moves the tasks or keeps their dates, or when the date moves back.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

from_date.description: The wedding date the open tasks were scheduled against.

noted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the latest move, from the injected clock.
